details.motherboard: standard Mini-ITX 170 x 170 mm mechanical interface with the standard mounting-hole and rear-I/O datums

motherboard_mounting.support_type: four integral cylindrical printed standoffs: three fused to enclosure hosts and one fused to a detachable lower-front mount arm
motherboard_mounting.fastener: four M3 screws into printed self-forming holes
motherboard_mounting.lower_front_mount_fastener: one underside M3 screw through the base into the detachable printed arm
motherboard_mounting.standard_interface_acceptance: mounting holes and rear-I/O conform to the standard Mini-ITX datum, and backside components remain inside the modeled keepout allowance

details.gpu: compact single-fan dual-slot card, inverted with PCIe fingers upward; power connector clearance handled by user
details.gpu_support: far-end U support fused to the removable front panel, with assembly clearance and soft-pad allowance; it is removed with the front panel and is not a standalone component
details.psu: standard SFX 125 x 100 x 63.5 mm, rear straight-in installation
details.sfx_rear_interface: four 4.2 mm holes at 113 x 51.5 mm spacing with unobstructed driver access
details.layout: six-piece 152 x 256 x 252 mm enclosure with standard rear Mini-ITX I/O, inverted dual-slot GPU, lower PCIe support beam and standard SFX PSU
details.storage: M.2 only; no separate drive bays
details.ventilation: large perforated side panels; solid front panel
details.front_io: one externally operable 12 mm panel-mount normally-open momentary power button only
details.panel_magnets: 15 x 10 x 4 mm embedded magnets retained by a centered screw
details.priority: verified hardware installation and maintainability within the fixed enclosure envelope

requirement_conflicts.prd_statement: four 4.2 mm holes at 113 x 51.5 mm spacing with unobstructed driver access
requirement_conflicts.observed_state: enclosure-integrated revision 269 generates the four SFX rear holes at 119 x 52.5 mm spacing because the hole centers are x=±59.5 mm and z=8.5/61.0 mm
requirement_conflicts.resolution_reason: 保留已确认的 113 x 51.5 mm SFX 后板接口要求，并把 CAD 后板孔位修回该要求。

requirement_conflicts.prd_statement: Thermalright AXP120-X67, 123.5 x 120 x 67 mm; compact dual-slot GPU within 180 x 115 x 40 mm; both must fit the fixed enclosure layout
requirement_conflicts.observed_state: enclosure-integrated revision 272 places the GPU shroud at x=-51..-11 mm across the CPU y/z region while the required 67 mm cooler projects from the motherboard component side to about x=-56.45 mm, producing about 40 mm of hard overlap
requirement_conflicts.resolution_reason: 用户指出主板方向错误；保留 AXP120-X67 与双槽 GPU 要求，翻转主板元件面并修正安装平面布局。

requirement_conflicts.prd_statement: removable far-end U support with assembly clearance and soft-pad allowance
requirement_conflicts.observed_state: The user deleted the separate GPU far-end support and requested that the support be integrated into the removable front panel instead of remaining a standalone component; enclosure-integrated revision 286 currently has no far-end support.
requirement_conflicts.resolution_reason: 用户确认取消独立显卡远端托架，改为与可拆前面板一体成型；拆下前面板时支撑随面板一起移除。

requirement_conflicts.prd_statement: one externally operable 12 mm panel-mount normally-open momentary power button only
requirement_conflicts.observed_state: enclosure-integrated revision 286 provides the front-panel circular cutout but no externally operable button body or actuator
requirement_conflicts.resolution_reason: 用户保留外部可操作电源按钮要求，并要求在当前 CAD 修改中补齐按钮实体或执行结构。

change_log.from: the standard interface statement included non-requirement planning prose
change_log.to: standard Mini-ITX 170 x 170 mm mechanical geometry is the complete product-level interface and acceptance boundary
change_log.reason: The active user decision authorizes the standard Mini-ITX interface as the complete design basis.

notes: The previous sub-4-liter/Flex-PSU/no-riser/no-GPU-support concept is retired. Current requirements follow the 152 x 256 x 252 mm SFX/riser/front-panel-integrated-GPU-support design. The motherboard mounts directly to four kit-generated integral cylindrical printed standoffs without brass standoffs or heat-set inserts. The lower-front standoff is integral to a detachable printed mount arm retained from beneath the base by one M3 screw; that arm must not be fused to the base. Standard Mini-ITX mechanical geometry is the confirmed compatibility boundary.
